source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Simple Hypothesis Testing Examples' under topic 7.4 (PDF 98, printed 94).

blocks.text: Saadi misalein testing samajhne mein madad deti hain. Ek misaal exam ke nataij test karna hai; doosri average qad (height) check karna. Samples se data jama hota hai, bunyadi tests se analyze hota hai aur nateeje wazeh tor par nikale jate hain. Saadi misalein aitmad barhati aur concept aasani se samjhati hain.
